arc_goal: Implement linked workflows MVP — parent-to-child workflow links with completion blocking, cross-partition cancellation, and observable state graphs. Success = end-to-end integration test passes with full create/complete/cancel/remove flow.

progress_update.summary: We conducted an interactive plan review of the Linked Workflows RFC suite, resolving 9 design questions through dialog. Produced precise implementation specifications: journal entries (OneWayCallCommand + CreateLink + AttachInvocationCommand), new types (Link/HandlerInvocation sink variants, LinkCompletionNotification, InvocationStatus::Completing), cross-partition from day one. Updated all RFC and design documents. Created new linked-workflows branch from service-macro (rebased to remove unrelated docs/tasks). Wrote comprehensive implementation plan with 6 phases. Plan awaiting user approval before task breakdown.
progress_update.goal: Implement linked workflows MVP with cross-partition support. Success = parent workflow starts linked child, child blocks parent completion, cancellation propagates through link tree, RemoveLink orphans child, end-to-end integration test passes.

progress_update.now: Implementation plan written and awaiting user approval. Next step is task breakdown via /spectre:create_tasks once approved.
next_steps: Get plan approval, then generate task breakdown via /spectre:create_tasks
Phase 1: Link table storage stack (storage-api traits, proto, partition-store impl)
Phase 2: New types (Completing variant, Link/HandlerInvocation sinks, LinkCompletionNotification)
Phase 3: Journal entries (CreateLink, RemoveLink commands and handlers)
constraints: Cross-partition links from day one — all link operations use outbox messages
Completing is a new InvocationStatus variant — touches ~29 files / 298 occurrences (compiler-guided)
Links stored in dedicated table with bidirectional keys (parent entity + child entity)
onCompleted only for virtual objects — workflows await via AttachInvocationCommand
Link table stores the child's result directly — links outlive invocation retention
decisions: Completion delivers Result<T, E> only — no status field, no inline frozen graph
Completing variant carries InFlightInvocationMetadata + buffered ResponseResult + active_children_count
Link table keyed by both parent entity and child entity (not invocation ID)
RemoveLink included in MVP — graph curation is load-bearing
End-to-end integration test included in MVP scope
State Introspection REST API removed — was speculative
No framework-level timeout defaults — owner controls via cancellation
Cancellation is local per node — each node cancels its own direct children
open_questions: Graph traversal API — how does a parent inspect the frozen state graph of completed children? (deferred)
Orphan GC policy — default timeout for orphaned workflows? (deferred)
risks: Completing variant touches 29 files — significant but compiler-guided ripple
Cross-partition link creation requires outbox coordination — adds latency to link setup
